rv.q: If you’re into the smutty vibe, Ancient Grease is a right laugh.
Ancient Grease has something they occasionally lack: pure, shameless fun.

I’ll be honest with you, a parody of the musical Grease, set in actual ancient Greece, is not really my sort of thing. But The Vault’s production of Ancient Grease won me over, and had me bopping, whooping, and chortling.
Ancient Grease is the word, and it has most certainly got groove and meaning.
The problem? It’s just not very funny.

cn.t: This irreverent Grease parody set in Ancient Greece divides critics with its outrageous, campy humor. While some praise its fun premise and comic timing, others find the ribald concept doesn't fully deliver on its potential.
